decisions.reason: As a small accessory with lower strategic visibility and limited leverage of the firm's core trailer platform, it is the easiest item to discontinue if learning and sales have been only modest.

An enclosed box trailer line sits squarely in the firm's established trailer know-how and dealer-service network, and its home-page prominence suggests early commercial relevance that the firm can further refine.

A car transporter trailer uses related chassis, safety and hauling capabilities but serves a more specialized niche, so the firm is likely to keep it while learning from the first years, though with some pruning risk.
Low-bed trailers are highly consistent with the firm's production and logistics capabilities, and their strong marketing visibility indicates a good fit with customer demand.
High trailer covers complement the installed trailer base and can be improved through customer feedback from service channels, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
This box car trailer series is close to the firm's core knowledge, though overlap with other trailer lines creates some rationalization risk if the portfolio proves too crowded.
